hook: IT IS *SUNDAY EVENING AND YOUR CHEST IS *TIGHT
title: F13 · sunday_dread · Sunday, 6 p.m.
lines: The weekend is over in your head already.
Tomorrow he will tear your work apart in front of everyone. Again.
Is this what you call effort?
You have heard it so often you say it to yourself now.
She looked down into her tea.
In it, a beggar was calmly tying a tiger's skin around his waist.
Everything they threw at him, he wore.
On Monday he said it again.
She wrote it down, word for word, and asked: Which part, exactly?
She wrote it down, word for word, and asked: "Which part, exactly?"
You cannot stop what is thrown. You decide what it becomes. That is sadhana.
